assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production game VFX sprite for a gigantic spectral greatsword floating behind an existing white armored sci-fi fantasy knight named Zero. The character is rendered separately.
Primary request: Design ONE imposing original-IP platinum-white double-edged greatsword, complete from tip to pommel, perfectly vertical with the TIP UP and pommel down. A monumental, broad elegant blade with faceted white-metal bevels, an icy cyan luminous central channel, restrained antique-gold seams, a sculpted angular crossguard and a clearly readable dark grip. Strong powerful silhouette, straight continuous rigid centerline; no bent blade. Refined 2D anime RPG painting with crisp edges and luminous spectral detail, matching white armor and a cyan energy sword. It must read as a huge ghostly sacred weapon, not a narrow decorative feather.
Composition: portrait 1024x1536. Entire sword centered near x=512. Tip around y=100; crossguard around y=1170; grip around y=1290; pommel around y=1440. Blade widens to about 290 pixels; crossguard about 470 pixels. At least 60 pixels clear transparent margin around every hard edge. Orthographic front view, no perspective foreshortening.
Lighting: razor white rim, icy-blue inner glow and sparse delicate flecks, faint translucent vapor close to the blade. Keep the metal and etched structure legible instead of an overexposed white blob.
Background: TRUE transparent alpha. No room, floor, sky, black matte, background light disk, ring, halo, wings, character, hand, body, stand, writing, watermark or UI. Only the single complete sword and its tight luminous edge. Preserve transparency in all empty areas.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent six-frame animated VFX sprite sheet for the downward finishing cut of an enormous white spectral greatsword in a 2D anime RPG.
Create ONE 1536x1024 landscape sprite sheet, precisely 3 columns x 2 rows of 512x512 cells, ordered left to right then top to bottom. All SIX cells contain consecutive frames of the SAME forceful descending crescent slash, with consistent registration centered at (256,256) in each cell. The blade's sweep runs from the upper left through the middle toward the lower right, like a heavy sword cutting downward. A thick sharp white leading edge, pale cyan interior, refined champagne-gold filaments, and bright small shards give the slash weight. This is a PAINTED flowing crescent of energy, with taper and internal striations, not a geometric ring or neon scribble.
Frame 1: a short charging white crescent at upper left. Frame 2: crescent grows down and right. Frame 3: strong full crescent reaches through the lower-right impact. Frame 4: broad white fracture and short radial shards at lower right, crescent breaking up. Frame 5: tapered residual slash and receding fine fragments. Frame 6: only faint transparent drifting traces. Keep each complete shape inside x=55..457 and y=55..457 of its own cell, with at least 50px transparent gutters. No overlap between cells, no grid lines, no labels.
Color: luminous WHITE dominant, small icy-cyan and platinum-gold accents, no red. 2D high-quality painterly anime game VFX, dynamic detailed sharp energy, controlled glow, true transparent alpha background. No sword object, character, wings, circle, scene, black matte, checkerboard, text or watermark.
